# digna Documentation

> Discover digna, the European AI platform for Data Quality and Observability. Built for on-premises and private cloud, digna monitors the quality of data directly inside your databases — ensuring compliance, performance, and sovereignty.

## Platform

- [Overview](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/overview/): Explore the core modules of digna — the European AI platform for Data Quality and Observability. Learn how each module improves the quality, observability, and reliability of data in your on-premises or private cloud environment.

### Profiling

- [Introduction](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/profiling/Introduction/): Profiling is the step that measures your data and produces the statistics digna Data Anomalies and digna Data Analytics are built on. It runs as part of those modules, entirely inside your database, and only aggregated numbers ever leave the source.
- [How It Works](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/profiling/how_it_works/): The mechanics of digna profiling — the snapshot query and the
- [Statistics](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/profiling/statistics/): The complete reference of statistics digna computes while profiling a data source — Row Count, Null Count, Sum, Average, string lengths, distribution counts — which attribute category enables each one, and how each is translated into SQL.
- [Datasets](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/profiling/datasets/): How digna Datasets split a data source into independently monitored subsets. Static datasets filter with a WHERE condition, Dynamic datasets group with GROUP BY, Hybrid datasets do both — plus relevance rules that suppress a status without suppressing measurement.

### digna Data Anomalies

- [Introduction](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_anomalies/Introduction/): Learn how digna Data Anomalies automatically detects volume drops, missing values, distribution shifts, and unexpected patterns without manual rule coding. Improve data quality and observability of data pipelines with AI-driven anomaly detection.
- [How It Works](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_anomalies/how_it_works/): How digna Data Anomalies works end to end — in-database profiling, robust prediction per series, a tolerance band derived from recent prediction error, and status rollup from check to data source.
- [Use Cases](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_anomalies/use_cases/): Real-world use cases for digna Data Anomalies in banking, healthcare, telecommunications, retail, and the public sector. See how AI-based anomaly detection catches missing loads, distribution drift, swapped columns, and unexpected KPI movements without rules or thresholds.

### digna Data Analytics

- [Introduction](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_analytics/Introduction/): Learn how digna Data Analytics reveals long-term trends, volatility, and data stability across KPIs. Detect shifts in the quality and observability of data, uncover hidden anomalies, and turn statistics into actionable insights.
- [How It Works](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_analytics/how_it_works/): How digna Data Analytics works — a regression fitted over a configurable window of profiled statistics, producing absolute and relative change and volatility, evaluated against user-defined limits.
- [Use Cases](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_analytics/use_cases/): Practical use cases for digna Data Analytics. See how trend and volatility analysis over column metrics reveals gradual data quality decay, unstable pipelines, and shifting business KPIs in banking, retail, healthcare, telecommunications, and the public sector.

### digna Data Validation

- [Introduction](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_validation/Introduction/): Discover how digna Data Validation enforces deterministic, rule-based checks with thresholds, ranges, and reference lists. Ensure compliance, auditability, and regulatory reporting in finance, healthcare, and other data-sensitive industries.
- [How It Works](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_validation/how_it_works/): How digna Data Validation works — the three rule kinds (rule expressions, uniqueness, referential integrity), how each becomes SQL, absolute and relative thresholds, rule templates, enumerations, and failed-record inspection.
- [Use Cases](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_validation/use_cases/): Practical use cases for digna Data Validation. Record-level rules for invoice compliance, regulatory reporting, reference data integrity, and audit evidence in finance, healthcare, telecommunications, and the public sector.

### digna Timeliness

- [Introduction](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_timeliness/Introduction/): Learn how digna Data Timeliness ensures data arrives when expected. Detect late or missing deliveries, monitor SLAs, and protect business processes from silent delays. AI-powered detection for improved data quality and observability of data pipelines.
- [How It Works](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_timeliness/how_it_works/): How digna Timeliness works — what counts as a delivery, AI-learned arrival prediction versus rule-based schedules, the alert margin, and how a delivery that never arrived is reported.
- [Use Cases](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/data_timeliness/use_cases/): Real-world use cases for digna Timeliness. Detect late and missing deliveries across large multi-source landscapes — with AI-learned arrival patterns and user-defined schedules for strict data contracts.

### digna Schema Tracker

- [Introduction](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/schema_tracker/Introduction/): Learn how digna Data Schema Tracker monitors column changes, datatype updates, and schema drift. Detect and alert on both intentional and unintentional schema changes to prevent ETL failures, broken dashboards, and loss of data observability.
- [How It Works](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/schema_tracker/how_it_works/): How digna Schema Tracker works — a stored column baseline compared on every inspection, the three change events it reports, why a rename appears as a removal plus an addition, and how the baseline advances.
- [Use Cases](https://docs.digna.ai/platform/schema_tracker/use_cases/): Real-world use cases for digna Schema Tracker. Detect added columns, removed columns, and data type changes before they break pipelines, dashboards, and downstream reports — with a timestamped, attributed change history.

## Installation & Deployment

### Operating Systems

### Linux

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/installation_deployment/Linux/Release%202026.06/installation_guide_digna_linux_2026_06/): Step-by-step guide to installing digna Release 2026.06 on Linux — system requirements, PostgreSQL setup, nginx or Apache configuration, backend and dashboard configuration, running digna as a systemd service, and upgrading to a new release.

### macOS

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/installation_deployment/macOS/Release%202026.06/installation_guide_digna_macos_2026_06/): Step-by-step guide to installing digna Release 2026.06 on macOS — system requirements, Homebrew and PostgreSQL setup, nginx or Apache configuration, backend and dashboard configuration, running digna as a background service, and upgrading to a new release.

### Windows

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/installation_deployment/Windows/Release%202026.06/installation_guide_digna_windows_2026_06/): Step-by-step guide to installing digna Release 2026.06 on Windows — system requirements, PostgreSQL setup, web server configuration, backend and dashboard configuration, running digna as a Windows service, and upgrading to a new release.

## Getting Started

### First Steps

- [How to create a data project](https://docs.digna.ai/getting_started/how_to_create_project/): Step-by-step guide to creating a new project in digna. Learn how to open the project section, enter details, and save projects with an interactive demo.
- [How to connect a database to data project](https://docs.digna.ai/getting_started/how_to_connect_database_to_data_project/): Step-by-step guide to connecting a database to an existing project in digna. Learn how to configure connections, provide credentials, and enable secure access.
- [How to add a datasource to project](https://docs.digna.ai/getting_started/how_to_add_a_datasource_to_project/): Step-by-step guide to connecting a database to an existing project in digna. Learn how to choose a connection, configure settings, and enable secure access.

### Scheduling

- [How to schedule a daily job](https://docs.digna.ai/getting_started/how_to_schedule_a_daily_job/): Learn how to schedule a daily inspection job in digna using the dashboard.
- [How to use crontab definition](https://docs.digna.ai/getting_started/how_to_use_crontab/): Learn how to schedule a job in digna using crontab expressions for advanced timing.

## Integration

### Databases

- [Overview](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/overview/): How database connections work in digna. Every source technology is reached over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string built from ODBC properties. Covers driver installation on the digna host, the Add DB Connection screen, property encryption, connection testing, troubleshooting and links to the per-technology guides.
- [Azure Synapse](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/azure_synapse_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Azure Synapse Analytics over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Supports serverless and dedicated SQL pools, with the required ODBC properties and digna-side connection settings.
- [Databricks](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/databricks_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Databricks with Unity Catalog over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Databricks ODBC driver, personal access tokens, HTTP path and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Hive](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/hive_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Apache Hive over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Cloudera Hive ODBC driver, authentication mechanisms, transport modes and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Netezza](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/netezza_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Netezza over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the NetezzaSQL driver, the required ODBC properties and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Oracle](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/oracle_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Oracle over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Oracle ODBC driver, the DBQ connect descriptor, TNS aliases and the digna-side connection settings.
- [PostgreSQL](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/postgres_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to PostgreSQL over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the psqlODBC driver, the required ODBC properties, SSL modes and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Snowflake](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/snowflake_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Snowflake over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Snowflake ODBC driver, programmatic access tokens, warehouse and role selection and the digna-side connection settings.
- [MS SQL Server](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/sqlserver_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Microsoft SQL Server over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Microsoft ODBC driver, the required ODBC properties, encryption settings and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Teradata](https://docs.digna.ai/databases/teradata_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Teradata over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Teradata ODBC driver, the DBCNAME property, logon mechanisms and the digna-side connection settings.

### Single Sign-On

- [Overview](https://docs.digna.ai/sso/overview/): How Single Sign-On works in digna using OpenID Connect (OIDC). Covers dashboard and backend configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and links to per-provider setup guides for Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, OneLogin, PingOne and AD FS.
- [AD FS](https://docs.digna.ai/sso/adfs_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Active Directory Federation Services using OpenID Connect — application group, server application, shared secret, permitted scopes and the matching digna configuration.
- [Auth0](https://docs.digna.ai/sso/auth0_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Auth0 using OpenID Connect — regular web application setup, allowed callback URLs, client credentials, tenant domain and the matching digna configuration.
- [Google Workspace](https://docs.digna.ai/sso/google_workspace_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Google Workspace using OpenID Connect — OAuth consent screen, OAuth client ID, authorized redirect URIs and the matching digna configuration.
- [Keycloak](https://docs.digna.ai/sso/keycloak_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Keycloak using OpenID Connect — realm and client setup, client authentication, valid redirect URIs, client secret and the matching digna configuration.
- [Microsoft Entra ID](https://docs.digna.ai/sso/microsoft_entra_id_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) using OpenID Connect — app registration, redirect URI, client secret, tenant ID and the matching digna configuration.
- [Okta](https://docs.digna.ai/sso/okta_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Okta using OpenID Connect — app integration, sign-in redirect URIs, client credentials, authorization server choice and the matching digna configuration.
- [OneLogin](https://docs.digna.ai/sso/onelogin_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with OneLogin using OpenID Connect — OIDC app creation, redirect URIs, client credentials, token endpoint authentication and the matching digna configuration.
- [PingOne](https://docs.digna.ai/sso/pingone_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with PingOne using OpenID Connect — OIDC web app setup, redirect URIs, client credentials, environment ID, regional domains and the matching digna configuration.

## Changelog

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/changelog/Release_202606/): Learn what’s new in digna Release 2026.06. This version introduces the new digna Python SDK, Docker deployment support, a redesigned dashboard experience, and extended import/export capabilities for data validation rules.
- [Release 2026.04](https://docs.digna.ai/changelog/Release_202604/): Learn what’s new in digna Release 2026.04. This version introduces advanced time-series analysis with Analytics Chart, reusable validation rule templates, enumerations for allowed values, and column-level relevance conditions.
- [Release 2026.01](https://docs.digna.ai/changelog/Release_202601/): Learn what’s new in digna Release 2026.01. This version introduces global database connections, logical datasources, anomaly relevance conditions, CSV exports, and advanced data validation including referential integrity checks.
- [Release 2025.09](https://docs.digna.ai/changelog/Release_202509/): Learn what’s new in digna Release 2025.09. This version introduces a modular architecture, five new modules, MFA via OIDC, and per-module notifications.
- [Release 2025.04](https://docs.digna.ai/changelog/Release_202504/): Learn what’s new in digna Release 2025.04. This version introduces the Inspection Hub, multi-language support (English, German, Polish), import/export of data sources via dignacli, the first release of Module Analytics, and an improved dashboard experience.
- [Release 2024.12](https://docs.digna.ai/changelog/Release_202412/): Discover what’s new in digna Release 2024.12. This version introduces a built-in scheduler, PDF reporting, flexible custom columns, dynamic snapshot query placeholders, and smarter threshold optimization to improve anomaly detection and data quality monitoring.

## Notes

- Every page is also available as raw Markdown: append `.md` to its URL, e.g. `https://docs.digna.ai/platform/overview.md`.
- `llms-full.txt` beside this file carries the full text of every page in one request.
- This documentation is published in 27 languages under a locale prefix (`/de/`, `/fr/`, `/es/`, `/it/`, `/pl/`, `/pt/`, `/sv/`, `/nb/`, `/da/`, `/fi/`, `/et/`, `/lt/`, `/lv/`, `/nl/`, `/cs/`, `/hu/`, `/tr/`, `/ro/`, `/sl/`, `/el/`, `/uk/`, `/ru/`, `/ja/`, `/ko/`, `/hi/`, `/ar/`). Each locale has its own `llms.txt`. The sitemap at https://docs.digna.ai/sitemap.xml lists every URL.
- The marketing site at https://www.digna.ai covers use cases, industry applications and company information not duplicated here.
